title: Cosmic Neutrino Background (CνB) Temperature Derived from the Stefan Boltzmann Law in R_H = ct Cosmolgy
content: We are proposing a temperature formula for the Cosmic Neutrino background (Cν)B tem- perature that can be derived from the Stefan-Boltzman law under certain assumptions, such as R_H = ct cosmology. Our derived formula gives a prediction of the CνB temperature of 1.9336K ± 0.0072K which is in line with the current literature on the topic.
